Our business practices are driven and exhibited daily by our three core values: to ENRICH purposefully, to CARE personally and to DELIVER professionally. We pride ourselves in being a highly employee-centric organization that truly puts our people (and customers) first! At Mohawk, these aren’t just words, they are demonstrable values that we put into action by our behaviors each day. We have been certified as a “Great Place To Work” for the past thirteen years…see what our greatest assets, our people, have to say about us here: Mohawk Global - A Great Place to Work!

**Position Summary:**

Mohawk Global is currently seeking a dynamic and experienced sales professional to join our Trade Advisory (MGTA) team as an Account Executive. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in sales, a deep understanding of CBP regulations and consulting services, and excellent public speaking skills. This role will involve selling our trade consulting services to clients and prospects, building relationships with key decision-makers, representing the company by speaking at industry conferences and events, and closing sales to meet revenue targets.

**Responsibilities:**

- Identify and target potential clients in need of CBP regulatory compliance solutions
- Develop and maintain a pipeline of leads and opportunities
- Conduct product presentations to showcase the benefits of our compliance solutions
- Represent the company at industry conferences, trade shows, and other events
- Collaborate with the MGTA team to create sales material and campaigns
- Negotiate and close sales contracts with clients
- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure customer satisfaction and retention
- Stay updated on industry trends and regulatory changes to identify new products offerings and better serve clients
- Occasionally assist in Trade Compliance related projects

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, International Trade, or related field
- 10 years’ experience in a role supporting CBP regulatory compliance
- Proven track record of sales success in the regulatory compliance industry
- Strong understanding of trade regulations, compliance standards and consulting services
- Excellent communication and presentation skills
- Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients
- Self-motivated and driven to meet sales targets
- Willingness to travel for sales meeting, conferences and events as needed
- U.S. Customs Brokerage License (preferred)
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

#### What you need to know about the Chicago Tech Scene

With vibrant neighborhoods, great food and more affordable housing than either coast, Chicago might be the most liveable major tech hub. It is the birthplace of modern commodities and futures trading, a national hub for logistics and commerce, and home to the American Medical Association and the American Bar Association. This diverse blend of industry influences has helped Chicago emerge as a major player in verticals like fintech, biotechnology, legal tech, e-commerce and logistics technology. It’s also a major hiring center for tech companies on both coasts.

#### Key Facts About Chicago Tech

- Number of Tech Workers: 245,800; 5.2% of overall workforce (2024 CompTIA survey)
- Major Tech Employers: McDonald’s, John Deere, Boeing, Morningstar
- Key Industries: [Artificial intelligence](https://www.builtinchicago.org/companies/type/artificial-intelligence-companies), [biotechnology](https://www.builtinchicago.org/companies/type/biotech-companies), [fintech](https://www.builtinchicago.org/companies/type/fintech-companies), [software](https://www.builtinchicago.org/companies/type/software-companies), [logistics technology](https://www.builtinchicago.org/companies/type/logistics-companies)
- Funding Landscape: $2.5 billion in venture capital funding in 2024 (Pitchbook)
- Notable Investors: Pritzker Group Venture Capital, Arch Venture Partners, MATH Venture Partners, Jump Capital, Hyde Park Venture Partners
- Research Centers and Universities: Northwestern University, University of Chicago, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Illinois Institute of Technology, Argonne National Laboratory, Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory
